releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.194: Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder support Custom weekday recurrence. All previous repeat options for each section, saved entries, snooze timing and limits, ringtone, notifications and unrelated features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder saved entries now show their name in a separate gold 3D badge sized to the text. Long names wrap within the badge without horizontal overflow. Existing date, event type, time, reminder status and details remain unchanged; saved data and reminder behaviour are preserved.
